assignments.title: SSE TASK 1: MODEL SYSTEM BASIC CONCEPTS
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Select one system you use daily and model the five basic concepts.
Define:

System boundary and purpose
•  3–5 components
•  one process object + initial / final states + 2–4 operations
•  one solution configuration that uses the system
•  value for two stakeholders

assignments.title: SSE Task 10: Mono - Bi - Poly
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Task: 

Select the system for analysis

Transform the system to the bi-system. Define the benefits for bi-system.

Transform the system to the poly-system. Define the benefits for poly-system.

assignments.title: SSE Task 6: Define Product microstages
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Task: 

Select the product (multifunctional).

Define use cases (2 - 3 use cases in the format of JTBD)

For each use case define the user’s role

For each use case define microstage 

For each microstage define useful function

assignments.title: SSE Task 7: Analyse SDLC stage
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Task: 

Select the SDLC stage for analysis

Define 3-5 microstages for the selected stage

For each microstage define the Interaction scenario (including stakeholder with its role)

assignments.title: SSE Task 8: Product variable decomposition
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Task: 

Select the 3 microstages from different stages

Make different decompositions for these microstages

assignments.title: SSE Task 9: Ideal system
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Task: 

Select the system for analysis

Define the useful function

Define the ideal system for the function

assignments.title: SSE TASK 2: BUILD A FUNCTION GRAPH
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Select one system and one meaningful function. Build a small graph that separates the behavior type from actual execution and effect.

Define the Function  carrier role · action · target role · EffectSpecification

Specify the expected manifestation  parameter + change or preservation + target/desired state

Define one FunctionRealization  implementing SystemComponent / configuration

Describe one FunctionExecution  actual carrier · target · context/time

Record FunctionEffect + EffectManifestation  include Initial/Final state OR Desired state + TimeInterval

Evaluate the result  compare with EffectSpecification; identify a defect if present

assignments.title: SSE Task 3: Define system hierarchy
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Task: 

Choose a system for analysis.

Define the supersystem that the initial system is a part of. 

Break the system down into its parts:

By components, or

By functional units

assignments.title: SSE Task 4: Define system evolution
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Task: 

Choose a system

Define the system that preceded the system under analysis

Determine the problems solved in the system under analysis

Determine the problems not solved in the system under analysis

Define the image of the future system

assignments.title: SSE Task 5: Define anti-system
assignments.subject: Soft Engineering
assignments.description:
Task:

Define the system.

Define function and action that system are performing

Define the opposite action

Define the useful system that performs the opposite action

Try to merge the initial system and anti-system
